The current ratio of 0.42 indicates severe liquidity issues, as current liabilities significantly exceed current assets, suggesting imminent difficulty in meeting short-term obligations. The debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 10.25 (calculated as total liabilities / shareholders' equity = 3,107,151M / 303,243M) reflects extremely high leverage, far above investment-grade thresholds. Although EBIT margin is healthy at around 25% (EBIT / revenue = 12,435M / 49,691M), the absolute EBIT is insufficient relative to the massive liabilities, implying poor debt coverage and high default risk.

DECISION: C
